headline: 世界模型当模拟器：动作听话、多视角一致
title_en: PrimeSim: a multiview world-model simulator trained on 30k hours of robot demos
tagline_en: An action-conditioned video world model that follows commanded actions and stays consistent across camera views, released with weights and code.
summary_md:
**What it is.** PrimeSim, a paper from Travis Davies, Wentao Ma, Lihao Guo and colleagues, is an action-conditioned, multiview *world model simulator*. You give it a robot's commanded actions and a camera setup, and it generates video of what should happen next, from several views at once. The team started from a pretrained video generator, midtrained on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations across 22 platforms, then posttrained it into an autoregressive simulator that runs at about 10.1 FPS.

**Why it matters.** A world model is only useful as a simulator if it obeys three rules: it follows the actions you command, it stays consistent between camera views, and it does not drift apart over long rollouts. The paper attacks each one: a unified cross-embodiment action representation with frame-aligned dual-path conditioning for action following, view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera IDs for multiview consistency, and a "fast-video, slow-memory" posttraining scheme with hierarchical temporal memory to limit error accumulation. Per the paper, it stays stable on long-horizon rigid and deformable manipulation, adapts to held-out robot platforms in 100–200 gradient steps, leads four of five WorldSimProbe suites against five open-source action-conditioned world models, and its rollouts are good enough to run GRPO policy optimization on.

**Can you try it without a robot?** The model weights, inference code and training code are released, so you can read everything. Running it is another matter: video generation of this size is not realistic on a Mac with 16GB of unified memory and no NVIDIA GPU. Realistically you can follow the code, watch released rollouts, and treat it as a map of how modern world models are built. Note: the arXiv ID and date in this entry look unusual, so verify the paper exists before citing it.

pick.title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
pick.one_liner: 一个能听动作指令、多视角一致的机器人世界模型模拟器。
pick.one_liner_en: An action-conditioned, multi-view robot world model that acts as a simulator.
pick.how_to_try: 权重和推理代码已开源，但视频生成模型在 Mac 16GB 上几乎跑不动，只能读代码、看 rollout 视频。
pick.how_to_try_en: Weights and inference code are open, but a video world model won't run on a 16GB Mac; watch rollouts and read the code.
pick.reason: 方向重要、开源良心、适合学世界模型概念,但吃算力,新人只能看不能玩。

没有本地算力就无法亲自复现推理

top.title: suniique/assembly-nist
top.one_liner: 用强化学习让仿真 Franka 机械臂把 20 种零件装到一起
top.one_liner_en: A single PPO policy that assembles 20 NIST parts with a simulated Franka arm
top.how_to_try: 在 Mac 上安装 MuJoCo，用仓库自带的预训练模型跑 demo 视频；训练需要多核 CPU，起步很慢。
top.how_to_try_en: On a Mac, install MuJoCo and render the demo with provided checkpoints; full training needs many CPU cores and is slow.
top.reason: 一个干净的开源 PPO 装配复现，有预训练模型和视频，适合学习强化学习，但无法复现原论文结果，且训练门槛高。
red_flags: 独立复现 AlphaNIST，作者不保证与原论文一致（不同仿真器、资产和起始分布），对比不严谨
许可证为 NOASSERTION，使用前需确认授权
构建插件要求 x86-64，Apple Silicon 上可能需要额外处理
全流程训练需 8192 个并行环境，Mac 上基本跑不动完整训练

top.title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
top.one_liner: 让写代码的 AI 智能体代替人做遥操作，在仿真里造出能直接训真机的数据
top.one_liner_en: A coding agent replaces human teleoperators, building sim data good enough to train real robots
top.how_to_try: 先读项目页的流程和 arXiv 论文；完整跑通需要仿真环境和渲染视频模型（建议云端 GPU），Mac 只能看代码，做不了整条链路
top.how_to_try_en: Read the project page first. Full pipeline needs a sim plus a video rendering model on cloud GPU; a Mac can only browse the code, not run it end to end.
top.reason: 用智能体自动造真机可用数据，成本优于遥操作且鲁棒性更好，思路有价值；但依赖视频生成模型，纯 Mac 新人难以亲手复现。
red_flags: arXiv 编号 2611 与 2026-11 日期可疑，无法核实真实性
摘要未说明视频渲染模型是否开源，复现门槛可能很高
未标注许可证，数据可用性存疑

top.title: NJU-R-L-Group-Embodied-Lab/SuperMimic-Repro-Sim2Real
top.one_liner: 用可求导的神经网络模拟器训练人形机器人模仿人类跳舞，并在真机上跳完46秒
top.one_liner_en: Trains a humanoid to imitate human dance using a differentiable neural world model as the simulator, deployed on a real G1.
top.how_to_try: 仅用Mac跑不了训练，但可下载Release的ONNX和LAFAN1数据，在Mujoco里跑play脚本看回放
top.how_to_try_en: Mac can't train (needs NVIDIA GPU). Download the LAFAN1 dataset and try the play/render scripts in MuJoCo to watch imitation rollouts.
top.reason: 真机舞蹈demo有说服力，教程与文档扎实，适合学世界模型与模仿学习；但训练要N卡，Mac只能看回放。
red_flags: 训练需Linux+NVIDIA显卡，Mac新人无法亲手跑
非官方复现，论文关键细节自定，LAFAN1得分低于论文(0.56 vs 0.82)
真机部署危险，需吊架与急停，不适合新手

top.title: TacVerse/TacVerse
top.one_liner: 一个双手操作的触觉+视觉数据集，每帧含四路触觉图像
top.one_liner_en: A bimanual manipulation dataset with four tactile image streams per frame plus camera views.
top.how_to_try: 在 Mac 上下载数据，用 LeRobot 加载几段回放；没有触觉硬件就看不直观。
top.how_to_try_en: Download on Mac, load a few episodes with LeRobot and replay; tactile streams are hard to feel without hardware.
top.reason: 触觉双手数据是稀缺方向，格式贴近 LeRobot 因而具备学习价值；但作者不明、日期异常，可信度需要打折扣。
red_flags: 作者与机构未知，数据采集质量与标注规范无法核实
发布时间标为 2026-09-01，日期可疑
